grammar_title: 形式主语 it(It is + adj./n. + to do / that 从句;It takes/seems/happens;It is no use/good doing)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第二册 Unit 4 Using language:it as an empty subject。句子围绕'突破界限'主题、地道;干扰项 that/this/there 在该结构中均不成立,使 it 唯一正确;零术语、纯应用题。

points.point: It is + 形容词 + to do(形式主语指代不定式)
points.overview: 真正主语是后面的不定式短语,前面用 it 作形式主语:It is important/necessary/vital/possible to do…。that/this/there 都不能这样统领不定式,故只能用 it。

points.point: It is + 形容词/名词 + that 从句(形式主语指代从句)
points.overview: 真正主语是 that 从句,前面用 it 作形式主语:It is true/clear/a pity/no surprise that…。that/this/there 在此都不成立,只能用 it。

points.point: It takes/seems/happens…;It is no use/good doing
points.overview: 固定句式:It takes + 时间/精力 + to do、It seems/happens that…、It is no use/good doing sth。主语位置只能用 it,that/this/there 都不行。

questions.stem: "____ is important to remember that diseases respect no borders."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是后面的不定式 to remember…,主语位置用形式主语 it;that/this/there 都无法这样统领不定式。

questions.stem: "____ is necessary to disinfect every surface in the ward."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 it 指代后面的不定式 to disinfect…;其余三项不能引出不定式真正主语。

questions.stem: "____ is vital not to take any chances during an outbreak."
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语,真正主语是 not to take any chances;that/this/there 均不成立。

questions.stem: "____ is possible for doctors from many countries to work as one team."
questions.explanation: It is possible (for sb) to do 的形式主语结构,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is hard to imagine the courage these health workers show."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是不定式 to imagine…,前面用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is wonderful to see strangers join together in a common cause."
questions.explanation: it 指代后面的不定式 to see…;that/this/there 不能引出不定式主语。

questions.stem: "____ is dangerous to enter the clinic without proper protection."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 it + 真正主语 to enter…,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is wise to listen carefully before you judge another culture."
questions.explanation: It is wise to do 结构,it 作形式主语。

questions.stem: "____ is essential for us all to collaborate to build a better world."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是 to collaborate…,主语位置用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is difficult to describe the bonds formed in such a crisis."
questions.explanation: it 指代后面的不定式 to describe…;其余三项不成立。

questions.stem: "____ is inspiring to have comrades from every continent on the team."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 it + 真正主语 to have…,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is rewarding to help people who have lost everything."
questions.explanation: It is rewarding to do,it 作形式主语指代不定式。

questions.stem: "____ is not easy to relieve a doctor at the end of a long posting."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是 to relieve…,前面用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is useful to learn a few words of the local language first."
questions.explanation: it 指代后面的不定式 to learn…;that/this/there 不能这样使用。

questions.stem: "____ is common to hear several languages spoken in the same room."
questions.explanation: It is common to do,it 作形式主语。

questions.stem: "____ is brave of him to risk his life to combat the disease."
questions.explanation: It is brave of sb to do 的形式主语结构,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is natural to feel nervous before your first day in the ward."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是 to feel nervous…,前面用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is safe to assume that teamwork saves more lives."
questions.explanation: 形式主语 it 指代不定式 to assume…;其余三项不成立。

questions.stem: "____ is impossible to win this fight without working together."
questions.explanation: It is impossible to do,it 作形式主语。

questions.stem: "____ is worthwhile to break down the boundaries between people."
questions.explanation: It is worthwhile to do,真正主语是不定式,用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is true that disease does not respect national boundaries."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是 that 从句,主语位置用形式主语 it;that/this/there 都不能这样引出从句主语。

questions.stem: "____ is clear that the whole team shares one common goal."
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语指代后面的 that 从句,其余三项不成立。

questions.stem: "____ is obvious that no single country can fight an outbreak alone."
questions.explanation: It is obvious that… 的形式主语结构,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is certain that their devotion saved many lives."
questions.explanation: 真正主语是 that 从句,前面用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is a pity that some patients could not be saved."
questions.explanation: It is a pity that…,名词后接从句,用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is a fact that the death rate in the clinic was very high."
questions.explanation: It is a fact that…,it 作形式主语指代从句。

questions.stem: "____ is no surprise that the boys' recovery amazed everyone."
questions.explanation: It is no surprise that…,主语位置用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is no wonder that such work creates powerful bonds between people."
questions.explanation: 固定句式 It is no wonder that…,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is well known that Edgar Snow wrote influential books about China."
questions.explanation: It is well known that…,it 作形式主语指代从句。

questions.stem: "____ is likely that more volunteers will join the mission next year."
questions.explanation: It is likely that…,真正主语是 that 从句,用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is strange that we still build walls between different cultures."
questions.explanation: It is strange that…,主语位置用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is lucky that both brothers made a full recovery."
questions.explanation: It is lucky that…,it 指代后面的从句。

questions.stem: "____ is a shame that prejudice still keeps some people apart."
questions.explanation: It is a shame that…,名词后接从句,用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is natural that newcomers feel culture shock at first."
questions.explanation: It is natural that…,真正主语是从句,用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is amazing that people from so many nations work side by side."
questions.explanation: It is amazing that…,只能用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is important that we remember the soldiers who died here."
questions.explanation: It is important that…,主语位置用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is a good thing that cultures can learn from one another."
questions.explanation: It is a good thing that…,it 作形式主语指代从句。

questions.stem: "____ is sad that the civil war divided so many families."
questions.explanation: It is sad that…,真正主语是从句,用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is fortunate that technology now connects us across the world."
questions.explanation: It is fortunate that…,主语位置用形式主语 it。

questions.stem: "____ is encouraging that minority actors are getting more leading roles."
questions.explanation: It is encouraging that…,it 指代后面的 that 从句。

questions.stem: "____ takes great courage to work in a disease clinic."
questions.explanation: 固定句式 It takes + 精力 + to do,主语位置只能用 it;that/this/there 都不行。

questions.stem: "____ takes many hands to build a community with a shared future."
questions.explanation: It takes … to do,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ took two years of civil war before the nation found peace."
questions.explanation: It took + 时间 的句式,主语用 it。

questions.stem: "____ takes patience to overcome the culture shock of a new country."
questions.explanation: It takes + 品质 + to do,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ seems that the world is getting smaller every year."
questions.explanation: It seems that… 的固定句式,主语只能用 it;there seems 后只能接 to be。

questions.stem: "____ seems that no border can stop people from helping one another."
questions.explanation: It seems that…,主语位置用 it。

questions.stem: "____ seemed that at least three languages were being spoken nearby."
questions.explanation: It seemed that…,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ happens that he was the only Chinese doctor on the team."
questions.explanation: It happens that… 的固定句式,主语用 it。

questions.stem: "____ happened that the two boys survived against all odds."
questions.explanation: It happened that…,主语位置只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is no use worrying about mistakes when you learn a new culture."
questions.explanation: It is no use doing sth 的固定句式,主语用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is no use pretending that prejudice has disappeared."
questions.explanation: It is no use doing,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is no good blaming others for the divisions in society."
questions.explanation: It is no good doing sth,主语位置用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is no good waiting for someone else to break the boundary."
questions.explanation: It is no good doing,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ takes time for two countries to build mutual trust."
questions.explanation: It takes time (for sb) to do,主语用 it。

questions.stem: "____ seems that technology has brought distant cultures together."
questions.explanation: It seems that…,主语位置只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ takes real devotion to relieve a doctor in a war zone."
questions.explanation: It takes + 品质 + to do,只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is no use complaining about a problem you will not tackle."
questions.explanation: It is no use doing sth,主语用 it。

questions.stem: "____ happens that many great speeches have broken old boundaries."
questions.explanation: It happens that…,主语位置只能用 it。

questions.stem: "____ takes courage to mount a platform and speak for equality."
questions.explanation: It takes courage to do,主语用 it。

questions.stem: "____ is no good keeping silent when people are treated unfairly."
questions.explanation: It is no good doing sth,只能用 it。
